name: BEngel - From Heaven to Hell
source:
You play an angel, sent from heaven to become the guardian angel of Tim, a typical young man on Earth. You are supposed to guide him, without him knowing you are even there. Unfortunately, the moment you make contact with him, he immediately becomes aware of your presence. Even worse though, while you can sense his feelings and thoughts, you cannot “direct” him in the slightest. He very much has his own mind, leaves you with an almost impossible task.

Since he is aware of you however, you can talk and communicate with him. Other mortals luckily are not immune to your blandishments. Morally questionable decisions however offer you the ability to enter mortal’s dreams as an Incubus. Since all demon are fallen angels, this is a dangerous route to pursue.

Tim on the other hand is in love with Jeff, the neighbor’s boy. He is in a relationship with a girl however and very attentive to his public image. Are you going to interfere?

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bengel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位从天堂派来的天使，成为地球上一名普通年轻人Tim的守护天使。按理说，你应该在不被察觉的情况下引导他。遗憾的是，刚一与他接触，他便立刻发现了你的存在。更糟的是，虽然你能感知他的感情与想法，却丝毫无法“指挥”他。他有自己的主见，这让你的任务几乎不可能完成。

不过，既然他知道你在，你们便可以交谈、沟通。幸好，其他凡人并不免疫你的劝诱。作出某些道德上值得商榷的决定后，你还能以梦魔的身份进入凡人的梦境。但所有恶魔都曾是堕天使，因此，这是一条危险的道路。

另一方面，Tim爱上了邻家的Jeff。然而，Jeff正与一名女孩交往，而且非常在意自己在公众面前的形象。你会插手吗？

[摘自[url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bengel]itch.io[/url]]
